data.gender_notes: Solly is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Solly is a name of ancient origin, derived from the elements sol (sun) and ly (solace or rest). This name signifies a person who brings warmth, comfort, and hope, much like the sun that shines down upon us. The name Solly carries the meaning “Sunny and Solace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Solly usually hope their child will grow to embody sunny and solace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
